account.privacyDesc: In accordance with civic digital data protection principles, you can export all your personal data and filed complaints, or request account deletion.

account.passwordRequired: Password is required to delete your account.
account.deleteSuccess: Your account has been deleted and anonymized. Thank you for your civic participation.

landing.heroSubtitle: Report local civic issues, follow their progress in real-time, and help build cleaner, safer, better-connected communities through autonomous verified work-orders.
landing.howItWorksSubtitle: From citizen report to field crew dispatch and verified resolution in 4 streamlined stages.
landing.stage1Desc: Residents capture photos and GPS coordinates in seconds. Zero bureaucratic paperwork.
landing.stage2Desc: Deterministic keyword matching classifies category, detects duplicates by proximity, and suggests priority.
landing.stage3Desc: Municipal officers review suggested recommendations and deploy closest field units with mobile telemetry.
landing.stage4Desc: Repair evidence is validated through dual-photo checks before status transitions to Resolved.
landing.roleBasedInterfaces: Role-based interfaces tailored specifically to Citizens, Municipal Officers, Field Workers, and Administrators.
landing.citizenPortalDesc: File complaints in 2 minutes, monitor real-time repair progress, and receive verification alerts.
landing.officerDesc: Assess rule-suggested recommendations, assign field crews, review repair evidence, and inspect the GIS issue map.
landing.workerDesc: Mobile-first task queue, live status updates, blocker reporting, and GPS photo evidence upload.
landing.adminDesc: Manage municipal user directory, approve staff accounts, enforce RBAC roles, and inspect audit logs.
landing.metricsSubtitle: Simulated demonstration performance across Tamil Nadu municipal evaluation sectors.
landing.futureGovTitle: Experience the Future of Smart Municipal Governance
landing.futureGovSubtitle: Explore the citizen report intake journey, municipal officer assessment and verification queue, and field worker progress tracking now.
